decisions.decision: Discussion of COA board member orientation and policies and procedures to be held until more board members are present.
decisions.quote: ms. lincoln suggested holding the discussion of coa board member orientation as well as policies and procedures until there are more board members present.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager's FY21 Council on Aging budget totals $159,813 to cover salaries, mileage, and supplies.
budget_items.quote: the coa fy21 budget from the town manager totals $159,813 to cover salaries, mileage, and supplies.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Doherty is asking the Town for an additional $5,000 this year for program expenses.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty is asking for an additional $5,000 from the town this year for program expenses.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Doherty said she will not have the same grant opportunities this year as in the past.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty explained that she won't have the same grant opportunities this year as she has had in the past.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Doherty will present the COA budget to the Finance Committee on February 20, 2020 at Town Hall.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty will go before the finance committee on february 20, 2020 at town hall.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A possible full-time, benefitted nutritionist position at the Eagle House is being developed; no cost figure was given.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty replied that she is still looking into job descriptions in order to create the position, that it would be a full-time, benefitted position

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board comment says the director's grade and step increase moved the position from Step 11 to Step 14, following a suggestion by Mr. Jeffreys.
budget_items.quote: as a result of mr. jeffreys's suggestion, the director's grade and step increase boosted the position from a step 11 to a step 14.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Seven applications received and five approved for the Town property tax work-off program; no dollar figures given.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty reported the committee has received seven applications, and approved five.

topics.quote: announcements: ms. lincoln wished a happy birthday to those members born in january.
ms. digiacomo motioned to approve the minutes of the december 10, 2019 meeting, ms. grant seconded. on vote, motion carried unanimously.
building report- hvac: ms. doherty reported that the boiler and air conditioning units are being replaced.
eagle house supporters report: ms. lincoln reported the supporters have nominated lori ann tessier to serve on their board, and there is still one vacancy.
board comment: ms. lincoln thanked mr. jeffreys for suggesting to keep the warrant article as written at special town meeting on november 12, 2019.
at 10:16 a.m., ms. o'sullivan motioned to adjourn, ms. digiacomo seconded. on vote, motion carried unanimously.
